pages.title: Fly Hybrid Machine
pages.text: Place two flies and poop inside. Each successful breed has a 20% chance to produce the recipe result; failures produce one parent.

pages.title: 5x5x5 Speed and Output
pages.text: The breeding chest scans a 5x5x5 area around itself about every 4 seconds.$(br2)Each poop block in range shortens the breeding interval by 0.5 seconds; the base interval is 60 seconds and the fastest is 1 second.$(br2)Each maggot block in range adds +1 output per successful breed and consumes one extra poop per output.

pages.title: Automation
pages.text: Insert poop and flies from the top and sides, and extract products from the bottom.$(br2)Work pauses when the output slots are full, so it works well with hoppers and pipes.
